note: Re-judged 2026-11-13 (independent auditor) after bae3903dbb changed reactor.go::locateTunnelLocked: only its doc comment changed (session-downs are now 'delivered (deliverSessionDowns)' with an order ticket instead of 'emitted'); the body, including newTunnel(..., r.reliableConfig(), ...), is byte-identical, and the other cited producers are unchanged apart from a placePendingCallLocked preallocation in reactor_dial.go outside handleDial. RFC 2661 Section 5.8: "If no peer response is detected after several retransmissions, (a recommended default is 5, but SHOULD be configurable), the tunnel and all sessions within MUST be cleared." This RID owns the configurable budget; RFC2661-5.8-3 owns the clearing MUST. TestRFC2661ConfiguredMaxRetransmitClearsTunnel sets max-retransmit 2 before the tunnel exists, disables HELLO dead-peer detection, asserts Established after each of the two allowed retransmissions (negative) and Closed plus the StopCCN log at the next deadline (positive), so ignoring 2 for 5 or exhausting early both fail. TestConfig_MaxRetransmit and TestReloadAppliesMaxRetransmit cover the default 5 and parsed values reaching the reactor.
